form_name: Application for Working on Weekends & Holidays

work_date.note: Application date (the work date); repeatable row keyed with order_no[]

working_hours.note: Expected working hours, HH:00 from 01:00-12:00; repeatable row paired with app_dt[]

repeatable_rows.note: One row per weekend/holiday work date; 'Actual Working hours Start/End', 'Times', 'Result (x1.5 Times)' columns are read-only, computed post-approval from clock-in/out, not form inputs

submit_flow.note: Not yet exercised live (read-only inspection only); dev/ipk_gw.py and ipk-submit.ts currently target AppFrm-027 (wrong form) for the 'working' type and must be repointed to AppFrm-074 with this field_schema
